name: design-orchestrator
description: Orchestrate external product-design and visual-design collaborators for repository iteration workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Bridge Codex with product and visual design copilots
interface.longDescription: Design Orchestrator is a local plugin shell for connecting Codex to external product-design and visual-design collaborators such as ChatGPT and Stitch, so repository iteration workflows can use real connected outputs instead of fallback prompts.
defaultPrompt: Connect ChatGPT and Stitch for repo product iteration
Check whether design integrations are actually reachable
Route product and style briefs through connected tools
